title: Displacing misinformation about events: An experimental test of causal corrections
overview: Four-condition, block-randomized online survey experiment (YouGov, Oct 13-16, 2012): dispatches about a fictional senator's resignation; control, innuendo, denial, causal correction; outcomes favorability, belief in bribery, belief in an investigation.

readiness.note: No blocking issues. Replay adaptations (delay tasks and recall omitted, no survey weights) are listed in task/task.json and the open decision issues.
